diagnosis.root_cause: The bow-to-Isha stall is an absent product step. dialogue_state.gd ends its objective chain after bow_training_complete, begin() returns accepted Isha conversations to D02, and data/isha_dialogue.json has no conditional lamp handoff. The candidate has no lamp, elemental progression or backpack state. Existing combat is usable but specialized around one training monster: sword contact, player contact origin, save safety and recovery retain single-monster assumptions. The HUD hardcodes level 1 and a 30-XP threshold. Separately, prior QA supports the tracker repair and settings focus repair; their remaining findings concern incomplete ordered coverage and effect observations. These do not justify another speculative layout patch or opening rewrite.

stop_conditions: Stop expanding after the two declared completion conditions; do not substitute cosmetic work for an unfinished ordinary player step.

If a selected component lacks compatible dependencies, licensing or a working target-engine probe, report the concrete blocker and preserve the source and current product. An unused copy or placeholder does not satisfy completion.

If a required Host action, resolution, audio or observation operation is unavailable, leave that acceptance cell blocked or insufficient_evidence. Do not add a self-driving sidecar, manufacture histories or weaken the assertion.
Native project and boot regressions must be repaired before handoff. Report any unfinished completion condition honestly.
Only Host and Tester may publish recapture, close issues or close first_chapter_lamp_review.

strategy.rationale: Replace repeated presentation-oriented treatment with an event-driven playable continuation. Restoring an existing trained-bow instance cannot supply the missing lamp branch. Repair the quest/world adapters, retain the live Snaiel enemy, health, melee and hitbox foundation, and adapt the operator-pinned GLoot and loot-table mechanisms for real rewards and controls. Use relevant Nodragem interaction components for reveal/operate transitions, with product facts remaining authoritative.
